sources.title: Pinned Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety model card
sources.evidence: Identifies exact model, NVIDIA developer, June 2 2026 Hugging Face release, merged Gemma-3-4B-it LoRA, text/image input, text safety output, custom policy and trained reasoning modes. Governing terms are OpenMDW-1.1 plus Gemma terms and use policy. Describes nominal 4B and 128K context. Re-fetched October 27: the exact card explicitly names Google Gemma-3-4B-it as the base and says the LoRA weights were merged back into it. The declared 4B size is nominal; no pruning, expert expansion, new encoder or resized student is described.

sources.title: Pinned configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma 3ForConditionalGeneration: 34 dense text layers, width 2560, vocabulary 262208, FFN 10240, eight query/four KV heads of 256 dimensions; 29 sliding and five full attention layers. SigLIP has 27 layers, width 1152, FFN 4304, image 896/patch 14, no pooling head. Context 131072. Re-fetched October 27: architecture and text/vision dimensions remain those of the identified multimodal Gemma 3 base; no routed experts or additional modality modules are configured.

sources.title: Pinned checkpoint index
sources.evidence: 883 tensor names mapped to five shards; metadata.total_parameters=4300079472 and metadata.total_size=8600158944. Both independently matched to exact config/code shapes and bounded shard headers. Re-fetched October 27: metadata.total_parameters still equals 4300079472. The earlier census is retained as historical evidence; no shard headers or weights were fetched in this pass.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor headers, first of five
sources.evidence: Read all five shards using separate HTTP 206 ranges for eight-byte length and exact JSON header. All 883 tensors are BF16 learned parameters, with every name/shape/offset reconciled to code/config. Complete count 4300079472; no stored buffers, quantization scales, packed tensors, unmerged adapters or MTP parameters.

sources.title: Gemma3 implementation at configured Transformers version
sources.evidence: Defines dense gated MLP, GQA projections, four per-layer RMS norms and q/k norms, tied LM head, multimodal projection and norm. Checkpoint key conversion maps the saved legacy prefixes. Rotary frequencies and embedding scale are nonpersistent buffers.

sources.title: Gemma3 configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Text config defaults tie_word_embeddings=true, establishing the absent lm_head tensor shares the saved token embedding. Uses configured dense Gemma 3/SigLIP architecture.

sources.title: SigLIP implementation at configured Transformers version
sources.evidence: Vision patch convolution, learned positions,27encoder layers with biased attention/MLPs and norms; no optional pooling head when vision_use_head=false. Position IDs are a nonpersistent buffer, not learned parameters.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator technical report
sources.evidence: August 27 report describes Gemma 3-4B foundation, combined image/text and custom-policy input, and reasoning trace supervision with /think and /no_think modes. Provides no separately defined active parameter count. Appendix A rank 8 differs from model-card rank 16; both describe merged fine-tuning, so no extra adapters are added to checkpoint total. ArXiv abstract page lists only v1. Reopened October 27 and read the fresh cached full text: Section 3 and Appendix A describe Gemma 3 supervised LoRA fine-tuning. Distilled reasoning traces are training data, not evidence of a resized student; custom policies are prompt inputs rather than a new model component.

sources.title: Pinned safety and reasoning template
sources.evidence: Builds moderation prompts from text, optional image and assistant response, supports custom policy/taxonomy and enable_thinking, default false. Uses 24 safety categories including economic harm; no tool-call serialization or execution protocol is defined.

sources.title: NVIDIA Build model card and endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct Markdown and page metadata give exact 4300079472 parameters,131072 context and text/image to text. Capability metadata claims function calling supported, contradicting NIM release documentation. Build release is June 2, while its March 16 HF/NGC dates and older overview conflict with exact 3.5 HF card and retain predecessor information. Re-fetched October 27: the explicit specification still lists 4,300,079,472 parameters, and the card identifies merged Gemma-3-4B-it LoRA weights. No separately defined active count is supplied.

sources.title: NVIDIA release article on Hugging Face
sources.evidence: June 4 publication announces 3.5 and describes configurable reasoning/custom policy on Gemma 3-4B. Conflicts with exact model card on license wording (older NVIDIA Open Model License),23 versus current 24 categories, and release-day wording; current card governs those specifications. Reopened October 27: the architecture section explicitly identifies Gemma 3 4B IT and LoRA fine-tuning; custom-policy and reasoning additions are input/output behavior, with no disclosed structural resizing.

sources.title: Contemporary model-date correction
sources.evidence: June 1 commit changes model date from May 2026 to June 2, 2026, corroborating the intended release date stated by current card; repo creation/upload history alone is not treated as public release evidence.

sources.title: OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1
sources.evidence: Actual agreement linked by both exact card and Build page; title/version OpenMDW-1.1. Applied in addition to Gemma derivative terms, not as a replacement for them.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Terms cover Gemma 3 and model derivatives, explicitly referenced by NVIDIA3.5 card.

sources.title: Gemma Prohibited Use Policy
sources.evidence: Additional use policy explicitly incorporated by the exact NVIDIA card alongside Gemma Terms.

sources.title: NVIDIA NIM2.0.5-variant release notes
sources.evidence: Exact3.5 entry says function(tool)calling and guided decoding are unsupported; this documents that NIM release, not every possible use of the raw checkpoint. Image-only requests unsupported: text must accompany images.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 7
sources.evidence: Independently reopened the original report. Table 7 identifies Gemma-3-4B Base as dense, with 4B total and 4B activated parameters. This establishes the Qwen research team nominal comparison convention for the named PT base, not a Google or NVIDIA active-count disclosure. Google names this PT checkpoint as the IT base (s18); NVIDIA explicitly fine-tunes and merges LoRA into that IT model (s1).

sources.title: Pinned Google Gemma 3 4B IT checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh official repository metadata explicitly names google/gemma-3-4b-pt in cardData.base_model and reports Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration with 4,300,079,472 BF16 parameters. This is the exact IT base named by NVIDIA; its architecture and aggregate total match the PT model and the merged NVIDIA checkpoint. Aggregate metadata only; no weights fetched.

sources.title: Pinned Google Gemma 3 4B PT checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh named-base metadata reports Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration and 4,300,079,472 BF16 parameters, matching the IT checkpoint. Together with the explicit PT-to-IT relationship and original training report, this supports transferring the nominal benchmark convention through that lineage; no count is borrowed from an unrelated sibling.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report, architecture and instruction tuning
sources.evidence: Downloaded and read the original report, including visual review of page 4. Section 3 says pre-trained models become instruction-tuned models through post-training with teacher knowledge distillation and RL; the teacher is not a size source. Section 2 and Table 1 describe the multimodal 4B model and shared SigLIP vision encoder. No new student size, pruning, expert expansion or added modality is disclosed between PT and IT, consistent with matching released metadata. No active parameter definition is supplied.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Figure 1
sources.evidence: Reopened the original HTML, downloaded its original PDF and visually inspected page 1. Figure 1 plots the exact Gemma-3-4B-IT label at roughly 4B on the Activated Parameters (B) axis. This independently corroborates the nominal convention for the exact NVIDIA base, without establishing an exact count or Gemma-specific component scope. The caption qualifier about the Kimi language decoder is not transferred to Gemma.

sources.title: Current exact NVIDIA checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 API response resolves main to the original audited revision 35645ed3543b7e7ffaed2e788699e57a5051497c and reports 4,300,079,472 BF16 parameters. Confirms that the pinned index and card still identify the current checkpoint; no weights were downloaded.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron LLM information table
sources.evidence: Freshly opened August 2026 family information page. The exact Content Safety 3.5 row gives nominal 4B dense and 4.30B actual. Unlike adjacent MoE rows, it does not separately label an active count; this table corroborates total size but does not establish total-active equality.

name.note: Exact 3.5 variant; separate from Nemotron 3 Content Safety and older Content Safety Reasoning 4B.

developer.note: NVIDIA developed this fine-tune; Google is the explicitly identified base-model developer.

family.note: NVIDIA markets the model under Nemotron 3.5; Gemma 3 is its architecture and base lineage.

release_date.note: Exact card gives June 2 HF release and Build gives June 2 endpoint release; contemporary June 1 card edit confirms June 2 model date. June 4 announcement is later. Build March 16 HF/NGC dates conflict with exact card and correspond to predecessor context. May 22 repo creation is not proof of public availability.

open_weights.note: Full merged checkpoint is publicly downloadable; all five shard headers accessed without authentication.

license.note: Both current exact cards name OpenMDW 1.1 and Gemma Terms plus Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. Release blog uses older NVIDIA license wording; do not transfer that to current checkpoint or omit Gemma restrictions.

parameters_b.note: Fresh pinned-index, current repository metadata and NVIDIA Build checks reconfirm the complete 4,300,079,472-parameter checkpoint. The prior complete census remains preserved: language 3,880,263,168, vision 416,866,032 and projector 2,950,272, with tied embeddings counted once and merged LoRA adding no separate tensors. No census was repeated or shards downloaded. The developer 4B label is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 4B inferred from the explicitly named Gemma-3-4B-it base and merged LoRA lineage. Qwen Team Table 7 publishes 4B activated for Gemma-3-4B Base; Google explicitly links PT to IT with matching architecture/count, and Kimi Team Figure 1 independently plots the exact IT model at roughly 4B. NVIDIA fine-tuning, configuration and matching total disclose no structural resizing, added modality or retained adapters. This preserves an original research comparison convention, not an NVIDIA disclosure or an equality assumption from dense architecture. Exact per-token participation and component/phase allocation remain undefined.

architecture.note: Dense Gemma 3 decoder with 34 layers (29 sliding, 5 full attention), SigLIP 27-layer vision encoder and multimodal projector; no routed experts. Generates labels and optional traces via tied language head.

context_window.note: Card 128K resolved to 131072 by exact config and Build explicit numeric specification; avoid baseline decimal 128000. Report 8000 is fine-tuning sequence length, not supported context maximum.

modalities.note: Text and an optional single image; output text labels and optional reasoning trace. NIM requires text with images; no audio/video or image output is claimed.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning trace supervision and evaluated /think mode; exact template enable_thinking supports on/off, default off. This is direct 3.5 evidence, not inherited from predecessor.

tool_call.note: Conflicting primary claims: Build capability metadata says supported; NIM 2.0.5-variant explicitly says unsupported. Exact checkpoint template is specialized for safety labels/traces and has no tool protocol, but absence is not proof of incapability. Clear model-wide baseline false pending checkpoint-level evidence.

patch.description: NVIDIA fine-tune of Gemma 3 4B for classifying text and image safety, with custom policies and optional reasoning traces.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 4.300079472B parameters including vision encoder and projector. Nominal active 4B is inferred through the documented merged Gemma 3 4B IT LoRA lineage using Qwen Team's activated-count convention, corroborated by Kimi Team's exact IT plot; exact per-token and component scope are unspecified. Context is 131072 tokens. Governing terms are OpenMDW-1.1 plus Gemma Terms and Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. The current card dates release June 2, 2026; June 4 is the launch article. Build function-calling metadata conflicts with NIM documentation, so model-wide tool capability remains unverified.

parameter_count_reproduction.method: Read exactly 8 bytes then exact JSON header from each of 5 pinned shards using HTTP 206 ranges. Reconstruct all 883 expected parameter shapes from pinned config and Transformers 4.57.1 Gemma 3/SigLIP source. Match exact key set, BF16 dtype, every shape and contiguous data offset; compare independent formula component sums and index metadata. No full weight payload downloaded.

formulas.language: V*D + L*(2*D*Q + 2*D*K + 3*D*I + 4*D + 2*H) + D; D=2560,V=262208,L=34,Q=2048,K=1024,I=10240,H=256. Tied LM head adds no second embedding.

parameter_count_reproduction.buffer_handling: Gemma embedding scale, rotary frequencies and SigLIP position IDs are nonpersistent buffers absent from checkpoint. Every saved tensor matches an nn.Parameter; learned norms and learned vision positions retained.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains the exact complete total of 4.300079472B, reconfirmed by the pinned index, current repository API and Build specification. Recover nominal active 4B through the explicitly named merged Gemma 3 4B IT LoRA lineage: Qwen Team Table 7 supplies the PT active convention, Google documents PT-to-IT post-training with matching checkpoint metadata, and Kimi Team Figure 1 visually corroborates the exact IT model at roughly 4B. Reopened NVIDIA card/configuration, technical report and release article disclose no structural resizing; distilled traces are training data and custom policies are prompt inputs. Focused searches and the later NVIDIA family table supply no more precise active definition. Preserve the other 12 field assessments and prior exact census unchanged; no shards or headers were downloaded.
